name: Mercenaries
summary: In Thelsamar, Magistrate Bluntnose hires passing fighters as Mo'grosh ogres press into northeastern Loch Modan. Ironforge's promised soldiers are months away, leaving the valley's settlements, excavations, and Stonewrought Dam exposed.

sections.title: Ironforge's Slow Wheels
sections.body: Ironforge has taken months to send help to Loch Modan. Two months passed before it promised a handful of soldiers for the valley's defense, and another two months will pass before they arrive. With Thelsamar's guards stretched thin and hostile forces gathering beyond the valley, Magistrate Bluntnose cannot wait.

sections.title: The Threat in the Hills
sections.body: Mo'grosh ogres have fortified a camp in the hills northeast of the loch. Their growing presence threatens Thelsamar, the Ironband Excavation Site, and the Stonewrought Dam. If the dam is attacked or damaged, the destruction downstream would be catastrophic. Without official mountaineer detachments, Bluntnose hires independent fighters to thin the ogre ranks and buy the valley time against ogres and troggs.

faq.q: Why is Magistrate Bluntnose hiring mercenaries instead of using guards?
faq.answer: Ironforge has been slow to answer Loch Modan's pleas for help. Two months passed before the Senate approved sending even a handful of soldiers, and another two months will pass before they arrive. With Thelsamar, the dam, and local dig sites facing immediate threats, Bluntnose hires independent fighters.

faq.q: Where are the Mo'grosh ogres located?
faq.answer: The Mo'grosh ogres are at the Mo'grosh Stronghold in the rugged bluffs and hills northeast of Loch Modan's great lake.

faq.q: Why is the Stonewrought Dam considered in danger?
faq.answer: The Stonewrought Dam regulates the entire lake and is an architectural jewel of the dwarves. With almost no military defense and a Mo'grosh camp nearby, Bluntnose fears an organized attack could damage or sabotage the structure and unleash catastrophic floods.

faq.q: What other threats does Thelsamar face alongside the ogres?
faq.answer: Troggs have erupted across the loch from underground ruins and excavations. Bluntnose sees them as a massive threat, but the nearby ogre stronghold forces him to hire fighters to push back the Mo'grosh so the local guard can focus on the trogg incursions.

angles.text: As a dwarf, seeing the Stonewrought Dam, a crown jewel of dwarven engineering, left unguarded because of Ironforge red tape makes Bluntnose's call to arms personal, whether you're a mountaineer or a traveler from the capital.

As an Alliance traveler, you know Loch Modan is a vital corridor between Khaz Modan and the northern kingdoms. Ogre raids that throw it into chaos threaten Alliance supply lines across the Eastern Kingdoms.
